title: Mobile Engineers Already Understand AI Infrastructure (Here's Proof) #shorts
caption:
Mobile engineer intimidated by AI? You already understand most of AI serving infrastructure. 🧠⚡

Production AI isn't a Python API call — it's an operating systems problem:
1️⃣ Low-Memory Killers → Preemption: when a GPU runs out of KV cache, the serving engine evicts a request exactly like the OS kills your backgrounded app.
2️⃣ Virtual Memory Paging → PagedAttention: same page tables, same fix for fragmentation.
3️⃣ 16ms Frame Budget → Time-to-First-Token: a hard budget the user can feel, and profiling until you find where it went.
4️⃣ Reactive Streams & Retry State Machines → Token Streaming & Model Fallbacks.
5️⃣ On-Device (ExecuTorch, CoreML, NPUs): your constraint intuition is the advantage. Backend folks are catching up here.

The real gap: non-deterministic outputs, embeddings, and cost-per-call as a design constraint. Learnable.
